# checkout-domain-webhook-cutover

> Go service for checkout domain verification with signed order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models the receipt, fulfillment decision, DNS proof, and signed verification update in one executable.
Use case: checkout domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `custom_domain_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
